# IMPERIA COLD WAR — COMECON 1970 (clearing in transferable roubles, price formula, IIB credits, plan coordination).
# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_CMEA_generator/build.py (do not edit by hand).

# Any scope. Reads the world oil price of the Cold War system (index, 1.0 = January 1970) and the gap to the formula price.
COLDWAR_CMEA_world_price = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px_world = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_px_world = global.mdcw_cw_oil_ratio }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_px_world min = 0.1 max = 20 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px_world_usd = global.cwcm_px_world }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwcm_px_world_usd = 1.8 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px_formula_usd = global.cwcm_px_formula }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwcm_px_formula_usd = 1.8 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px_diff = global.cwcm_px_world }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.cwcm_px_diff = global.cwcm_px_formula }
}

# Any scope. The Bucharest formula of 1958 at the start: the average world price of the five previous years.
COLDWAR_CMEA_prices_init = {
	# five yearly samples before 1970: the price before the oil crisis
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px4 = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px5 = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px_formula = 1 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jan1 = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px_next = cwcm_t_next }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_world_price = yes
}

# Any scope. Formula price = average of the five yearly samples.
COLDWAR_CMEA_prices_average = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px_formula = global.cwcm_px1 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_px_formula = global.cwcm_px2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_px_formula = global.cwcm_px3 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_px_formula = global.cwcm_px4 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_px_formula = global.cwcm_px5 }
	divide_variable = { global.cwcm_px_formula = 5 }
}

# Any scope. Every 1 January: a new sample; after B2 the formula follows the moving five-year average every year.
COLDWAR_CMEA_prices_year = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_world_price = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px5 = global.cwcm_px4 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px4 = global.cwcm_px3 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px3 = global.cwcm_px2 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px2 = global.cwcm_px1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px1 = global.cwcm_px_world }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_formula_annual }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_prices_average = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jan1 = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_px_next = cwcm_t_next }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_world_price = yes
}

# Any scope. Start of a five-year plan: the formula price is fixed for the period.
COLDWAR_CMEA_prices_period = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_prices_average = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_world_price = yes
}

# Any scope. Clearing in transferable roubles (design 9): oil importers save the gap between world and formula price on their deficit (at most 1.5 % of GDP), the suppliers carry it by their deliveries (at most 2 % of GDP); programme costs and IIB repayments; the balances of the clearing sum to zero.
COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_world_price = yes
	# 0. reset; partners outside the Council only take part in loans and programmes abroad
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwcm_bg_pay = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_bg_recv = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_settle = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_st_total = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_st_sup_w = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_st_sup_gdp = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_st_sup_raw = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_st_n_sup = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_st_n_imp = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_hard_currency has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_dissolved } }
		# world prices: the clearing has ended
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_importer
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_supplier
				set_variable = { cwcm_oil_bal = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		# 1. oil balance of every member: suppliers (surplus) and importers (deficit)
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_variable = { cwcm_oil_bal = resource_produced@oil }
				subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_oil_bal = resource_consumed@oil }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cwcm_quota } }
					set_variable = { cwcm_quota = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_oil_bal > 0.5 } }
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_supplier
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_importer
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_oil_bal }
					add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_st_sup_raw = cwcm_t_x }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_quota }
					add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_st_sup_w = cwcm_t_x }
					add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_st_sup_gdp = gdp_total }
					add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_st_n_sup = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_oil_bal < -0.5 } }
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_importer
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_supplier
					add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_st_n_imp = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_importer
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_supplier
				}
			}
		}
		# 2. the share of the deliveries the suppliers keep up (delivery quota)
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_st_q = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_st_sup_raw > 0 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_st_q = global.cwcm_st_sup_w }
			divide_variable = { global.cwcm_st_q = global.cwcm_st_sup_raw }
		}
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_quota_ind = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwcm_quota_ind = global.cwcm_st_q }
		multiply_variable = { global.cwcm_quota_ind = -0.1 }
		# 3. importers: (world price - formula price) x deficit; Soyuz and Yamburg participants are repaid in gas (+5 %)
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_st_n_sup > 0 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_importer }
						set_variable = { cwcm_settle = cwcm_oil_bal }
						multiply_variable = { cwcm_settle = -1 }
						multiply_variable = { cwcm_settle = global.cwcm_px_diff }
						multiply_variable = { cwcm_settle = 0.558 }
						multiply_variable = { cwcm_settle = global.cwcm_st_q }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_settle > 0 }
								OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_M1 has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_M3 } }
							multiply_variable = { cwcm_settle = 1.05 }
						}
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_cap = gdp_total }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_cap = 0.015 }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_capn = cwcm_t_cap }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_capn = -1 }
						clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_settle min = cwcm_t_capn max = cwcm_t_cap }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_st_total = cwcm_settle }
					}
				}
			}
			# 4. the suppliers carry the sum by their deliveries, at most 2 % of their GDP
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_cap = global.cwcm_st_sup_gdp }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_cap = 0.02 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_abs = global.cwcm_st_total }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_abs < 0 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_abs = -1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_abs > cwcm_t_cap } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_f = cwcm_t_cap }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_f = cwcm_t_abs }
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwcm_members
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						if = {
							limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_importer }
							multiply_variable = { cwcm_settle = cwcm_t_f }
						}
					}
				}
				multiply_variable = { global.cwcm_st_total = cwcm_t_f }
			}
			clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_st_sup_w min = 0.001 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_supplier }
						set_variable = { cwcm_settle = cwcm_oil_bal }
						multiply_variable = { cwcm_settle = cwcm_quota }
						divide_variable = { cwcm_settle = global.cwcm_st_sup_w }
						multiply_variable = { cwcm_settle = global.cwcm_st_total }
						multiply_variable = { cwcm_settle = -1 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# 5. clearing into payments and receipts (annual)
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_settle > 0 } }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_bg_recv = cwcm_settle }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_settle }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = -1 }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_bg_pay = cwcm_t_x }
			}
		}
	}
	# 6. programmes and assistance abroad: the participants pay by GDP share (computed with the programmes)
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_bg_pay = cwcm_prog_pay }
			add_to_variable = { cwcm_bg_pay = cwcm_aid_pay }
		}
	}
	# 7. IIB credits: repayments with interest to the lenders
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_target > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_ly = global.cwcm_l1_weekly }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_ly = 52 }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwcm_l1_target = { exists = yes } } var:global.cwcm_l1_target = { add_to_variable = { cwcm_bg_pay = cwcm_t_ly } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lg = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_l1_lenders
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lg = gdp_total } }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_lg min = 0.001 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_l1_lenders
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_lg }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_ly }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_bg_recv = cwcm_t_x }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_target > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_ly = global.cwcm_l2_weekly }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_ly = 52 }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwcm_l2_target = { exists = yes } } var:global.cwcm_l2_target = { add_to_variable = { cwcm_bg_pay = cwcm_t_ly } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lg = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_l2_lenders
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lg = gdp_total } }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_lg min = 0.001 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_l2_lenders
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_lg }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_ly }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_bg_recv = cwcm_t_x }
			}
		}
	}
	# 8. weekly values for the MD money system, net in $M per week
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwcm_wk_pay = cwcm_bg_pay }
			divide_variable = { cwcm_wk_pay = 52 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_wk_recv = cwcm_bg_recv }
			divide_variable = { cwcm_wk_recv = 52 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_net = cwcm_bg_recv }
			subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_net = cwcm_bg_pay }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_net = 19.231 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_settle_wk = cwcm_settle }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_settle_wk = 19.231 }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_rank_balances = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Who supplies whom: the five largest suppliers and the five largest beneficiaries of the clearing.
COLDWAR_CMEA_rank_balances = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_settle_wk < cwcm_t_best }  }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_settle_wk }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_pay1 = cwcm_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_pay1_v = cwcm_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_settle_wk > cwcm_t_best }  }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_settle_wk }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_rec1 = cwcm_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_rec1_v = cwcm_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_settle_wk < cwcm_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_pay1 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_settle_wk }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_pay2 = cwcm_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_pay2_v = cwcm_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_settle_wk > cwcm_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_rec1 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_settle_wk }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_rec2 = cwcm_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_rec2_v = cwcm_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_settle_wk < cwcm_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_pay1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_pay2 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_settle_wk }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_pay3 = cwcm_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_pay3_v = cwcm_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_settle_wk > cwcm_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_rec1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_rec2 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_settle_wk }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_rec3 = cwcm_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_rec3_v = cwcm_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_settle_wk < cwcm_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_pay1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_pay2 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_pay3 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_settle_wk }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_pay4 = cwcm_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_pay4_v = cwcm_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_settle_wk > cwcm_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_rec1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_rec2 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_rec3 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_settle_wk }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_rec4 = cwcm_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_rec4_v = cwcm_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_settle_wk < cwcm_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_pay1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_pay2 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_pay3 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_pay4 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_settle_wk }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_pay5 = cwcm_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_pay5_v = cwcm_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_settle_wk > cwcm_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_rec1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_rec2 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_rec3 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_top_rec4 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_settle_wk }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_rec5 = cwcm_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_top_rec5_v = cwcm_t_best }
}

# Country scope (supplier, player). temp cwcm_t_v: delivery quota 1, 0.9 or 0.8. A cut holds at least one year; importers resent it.
COLDWAR_CMEA_set_quota = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_old = cwcm_quota }
	set_variable = { cwcm_quota = cwcm_t_v }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_quota < cwcm_t_old } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_quota_lock days = 365 value = 1 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_importer NOT = { tag = PREV } } add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_quota_cut } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. IIB credit (design 9.4): the borrower in the context receives 1.5 % of its GDP, the interested members lend by GDP share; repayment over five years with 2 % interest to the lenders.
COLDWAR_CMEA_start_loan = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = { set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_amt = gdp_total } multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_amt = 0.015 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_target = 0 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_amount = cwcm_t_amt }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_weekly = cwcm_t_amt }
			multiply_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_weekly = 0.00423 }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_end = global.num_days }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_end = 1820 }
			clear_array = global.cwcm_l1_lenders
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_ctx_target } } } add_to_array = { global.cwcm_l1_lenders = THIS } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lg = 0 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_l1_lenders
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lg = gdp_total }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_target = 0 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 2 }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_amount = cwcm_t_amt }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_weekly = cwcm_t_amt }
			multiply_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_weekly = 0.00423 }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_end = global.num_days }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_end = 1820 }
			clear_array = global.cwcm_l2_lenders
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_ctx_target } } } add_to_array = { global.cwcm_l2_lenders = THIS } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lg = 0 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_l2_lenders
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lg = gdp_total }
			}
		}
		# the interested members lend by GDP share (paid only when a credit slot was free)
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_lenders^num > 0 } }
				var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = { set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_amt } modify_treasury_effect = yes }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_lg min = 0.001 }
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwcm_l1_lenders
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
					divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_lg }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_amt }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				# no lender: no credit
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_target = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_weekly = 0 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_lenders^num > 0 } }
				var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = { set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_amt } modify_treasury_effect = yes }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_lg min = 0.001 }
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwcm_l2_lenders
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
					divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_lg }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_amt }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				# no lender: no credit
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_target = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_weekly = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Repaid credits close.
COLDWAR_CMEA_loans_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_target > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_l1_end } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_target = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_weekly = 0 }
		clear_array = global.cwcm_l1_lenders
		COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_target > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_l2_end } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_target = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_weekly = 0 }
		clear_array = global.cwcm_l2_lenders
		COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. The first register of the plan coordination.
COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_init = {
	# the register for 1971-75 is open until 31 December 1970
	COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jan1 = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_close = cwcm_t_next }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_open = global.cwcm_plan_close }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_open = -365 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_year = 1971 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_cur = 1966 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_count = yes
}

# Country scope (passive member). Fixed sectors of the passive members (design 8).
COLDWAR_CMEA_ai_sectors = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SOV }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 5 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = DDR }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 2 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = CZE }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 3 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = HUN }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 3 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = POL }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 8 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = BUL }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 4 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ROM }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 2 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = MON }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 6 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = CUB }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 6 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = VIE }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 6 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SER }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 3 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 0 }
	}
	# a passive member admitted during a five-year plan takes part with its fixed sectors at once
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_cur > 1970 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = cwcm_sp1 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = cwcm_sp2 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_evaluate = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_count = yes
}

# Any scope. How many members filed each sector for the coming period (shown in the register).
COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_count = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_sec1_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_sec2_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_sec3_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_sec4_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_sec5_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_sec6_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_sec7_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_sec8_n = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 1 } check_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 1 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_sec1_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 2 } check_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 2 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_sec2_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 3 } check_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 3 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_sec3_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 4 } check_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 4 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_sec4_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 5 } check_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 5 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_sec5_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 6 } check_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 6 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_sec6_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 7 } check_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 7 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_sec7_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 8 } check_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 8 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_sec8_n = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Plan coordination in force: specialists get the sector bonus (x1.5 after A1), parallel production costs political power, every filed sector costs bureaucracy, every member gains trade opinion per sector with specialists.
COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_evaluate = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec1_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec2_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec3_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec4_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec5_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec6_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec7_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec8_n = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 1 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 1 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_esec1_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 2 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 2 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_esec2_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 3 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 3 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_esec3_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 4 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 4 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_esec4_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 5 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 5 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_esec5_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 6 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 6 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_esec6_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 7 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 7 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_esec7_n = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 8 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 8 } } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_esec8_n = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_div = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec1_n > 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec1_st = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec1_n > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec1_st = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_div = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec1_st = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec2_n > 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec2_st = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec2_n > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec2_st = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_div = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec2_st = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec3_n > 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec3_st = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec3_n > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec3_st = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_div = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec3_st = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec4_n > 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec4_st = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec4_n > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec4_st = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_div = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec4_st = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec5_n > 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec5_st = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec5_n > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec5_st = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_div = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec5_st = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec6_n > 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec6_st = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec6_n > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec6_st = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_div = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec6_st = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec7_n > 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec7_st = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec7_n > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec7_st = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_div = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec7_st = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec8_n > 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec8_st = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec8_n > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec8_st = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_div = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_esec8_st = 0 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_plan_div max = 8 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_mult = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_committee }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_mult = 1.5 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwcm_pl_AP = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_pl_BK = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_pl_FO = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_pl_HM = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_pl_IB = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_pl_IND = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_pl_KG = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_pl_PP = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_pl_REX = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_pl_ZP = 0 }
			# division of labour: trade opinion +1 % for every sector with specialists
			set_variable = { cwcm_pl_HM = global.cwcm_plan_div }
			multiply_variable = { cwcm_pl_HM = 0.01 }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 1 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 1 } } }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_BK = 0.01 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec1_st = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.03 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_mult }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_IND = cwcm_t_x }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec1_st = 2 } }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_PP = -0.02 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 2 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 2 } } }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_BK = 0.01 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec2_st = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.02 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_mult }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_ZP = cwcm_t_x }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec2_st = 2 } }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_PP = -0.02 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 3 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 3 } } }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_BK = 0.01 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec3_st = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.03 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_mult }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_ZP = cwcm_t_x }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec3_st = 2 } }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_PP = -0.02 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 4 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 4 } } }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_BK = 0.01 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec4_st = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.03 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_mult }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_FO = cwcm_t_x }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec4_st = 2 } }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_PP = -0.02 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 5 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 5 } } }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_BK = 0.01 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec5_st = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.08 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_mult }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_REX = cwcm_t_x }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec5_st = 2 } }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_PP = -0.02 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 6 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 6 } } }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_BK = 0.01 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec6_st = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.06 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_mult }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_AP = cwcm_t_x }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec6_st = 2 } }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_PP = -0.02 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 7 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 7 } } }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_BK = 0.01 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec7_st = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = -0.02 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_mult }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_KG = cwcm_t_x }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec7_st = 2 } }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_PP = -0.02 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 8 } check_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 8 } } }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_BK = 0.01 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec8_st = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.06 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_mult }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_IB = cwcm_t_x }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_esec8_st = 2 } }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_pl_PP = -0.02 }
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_plan } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_plan } }
			force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. 1 January of a new five-year plan: the register closes and the sectors take effect for five years.
COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_period_start = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_CMEA plan period [?global.cwcm_plan_year] starts"
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_cur = global.cwcm_plan_year }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_year = 5 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = cwcm_sp1 }
			set_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = cwcm_sp2 }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_evaluate = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_close = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_close = 1825 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_open = global.cwcm_plan_close }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_plan_open = -365 }
	# the formula price is fixed for the new plan period (before B2)
	COLDWAR_CMEA_prices_period = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 16 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev24_res = 16 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.24 } }
	}
}

# Country scope (player member). temp cwcm_t_v: files the sector (or withdraws it when already filed); two sectors at most.
COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_file = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = cwcm_t_v } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = cwcm_sp2 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = cwcm_t_v } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = cwcm_t_v }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = cwcm_t_v }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_count = yes
}
